notRunStatement: NOT RUN. No browser, no GPU, no preview, no npm verify/build, no capture. verification-ready.json ready=false and verifier-control.json action=hold at preparation time, so the probe's own preflight guard refuses launch; that refusal was exercised statically (exit 3, launched=false) and no browser process was created.

precisionCorrectionsHonoured.surveyExcursionIsNotCornerRecovery: The survey free-drawing loop is NOT used as corner evidence. The deviation under test is the COMMON early turn at z 15.82 on the E->C route, before the z=16 corner, and its verdict is computed only from common.terraUnits, frontier return and traversal of the omitted corner.
precisionCorrectionsHonoured.oldManual4Motion: No blanket claim that earlier manual attempts never moved; only this run's own key receipts are asserted.
precisionCorrectionsHonoured.clearanceIsMeasuredNotChosen: Body clearance is the live measured distance between the player's grounded pose and the worker's live position (>= 1 unit), never a desired standpoint's distance from a planned span.
precisionCorrectionsHonoured.timestamps: Every timestamp is written from actual wall clock at the moment of writing; no future-dated fields.

designedProof.phaseA: readiness (finite, non-initial, settled, actually supported body + worldBound), identity (<title>Paravoxia</title> + hardware ANGLE + headed), real shipped-canvas click AFTER readiness, pointer lock + focus + input policy, four ordinary key receipts with horizontal motion and distinct measured directions
designedProof.phaseB: survey earned by ordinary keys/F: W offer -> S begin recording (anc.cg.survey-started) -> 18-vertex authored long route drawn -> [F] offer span at E -> authored witness hold answered at W with the authored [F] -> anc.cg.route-tested -> beat ch13-common with objective ch13:common:reciprocal
designedProof.phaseC: H reference held by W (stage=holding-h + anc.cg.reciprocal-reference + worker body at H), then Terra's ordered E->C traversal of the ten-vertex 18-unit CG_ROUTE_COMMON with per-step sampling of terraUnits, supported, pose vs capsule centre, and worker clearance
designedProof.phaseC_deviation_mode: --mode deviation: walk to (-42,14), turn early at z 15.82 BEFORE the z=16 corner, cut to vertex 3, complete every remaining vertex to C (must buy no credit), then return ordinarily back along the route to the frontier at z 15.82, physically traverse the omitted corner at (-42,16), and resume the ordered remainder — with NO extra F, NO reset, NO teleport, NO endpoint pumping
designedProof.phaseD: far reference T: ordinary walk, exact objective ch13:common:offer-final-reference and literal '[F] Offer this end' prompt checked BEFORE pressing F; assert finalReferenceOffered && finalReferenceOccupied && anc.cg.final-reference-offered
designedProof.phaseE: release: hold occupancy at T while W walks H->E and tests the full span; assert workerUnits >= 18, committed, anc.cg.complete and anc.cg.handback, occupancy held throughout, clearance maintained

expectedPhysicalAssertions: terraUnits >= 18 - 1e-6 (full actual eighteen-unit ordered passage; endpoint separation of 6 units is explicitly not the passage)
physical arrival: grounded pose within 1.0 unit of C in XZ, with supported === true at arrival
live reference evidenced by credit actually accruing while walking (routeProgressUnits only advances under walkedSegmentSupported + checkReference)
every ordered common leg reached by measured distance (no timeout/stall counted as arrival)
minimum measured player/worker body clearance >= 1 unit throughout
earned prefix never lost (monotone terraUnits) and zero extra F presses / resets during the passage
anc.cg.reciprocal-crossed, then finalReferenceOffered+Occupied, then workerUnits >= 18 with committed + anc.cg.complete + anc.cg.handback
stoppingConditions: preflight refusal (ready=false, control hold, foreign activeRole, missing --url/--out, missing external heavy lock, source-manifest drift) — exits 3 BEFORE any browser launch
unusable or unsettled or unsupported body, missing world binding, no pointer lock/focus, policy blocks movement
any walk leg not reached (timeout, stall, no calibrated key) — probe STOPS immediately, never labels arrival, and performs no later F or action
any F whose exact current objective or literal prompt is absent — probe stops instead of pressing
passage verdict not ok at C — stops before the T offer and the release phase
verdicts: STOPPED-PREREQUISITE (exit 2, with stoppedAt and stop screenshot/state)

Sub-verdicts: passageVerdict -> FULL-EIGHTEEN-UNIT-PASSAGE-OBSERVED | PASSAGE-NOT-PROVED | INCONCLUSIVE-UNAVAILABLE-FIELD; recoveryVerdict -> EARLY-CORNER-RECOVERY-EARNED-THROUGH-OMITTED-GROUND | RECOVERY-FAILED-CREDIT-NOT-RESTORED | NO-STALL-OBSERVED-CASE-NOT-EXERCISED | RECOVERY-CLAIM-UNSOUND | INCONCLUSIVE-UNAVAILABLE-FIELD

selfTestCoverage: route geometry copies still total 18 units, E->C, ten vertices; early turn is on segment 2 below z=16

timeout and stall never read as arrival; non-finite distance never reads as arrival
mandatory prompt/objective negatives: no prompt, wrong verb, wrong objective all refuse F

recommendedRootInvocation.twoRunsRationale: terraUnits is monotone within one run, so a clean ordinary reference route and the early-deviation/recovery case cannot both be exercised in one session. Run reference first (clean route baseline), then deviation (the CG-IMPL-009 question) as a separate capture.

knownLimitations: NOT RUN: no runtime, rendering, audio, performance or creative fact is measured or claimed here.
Entry is the labelled deep fixture ?story=ch13-survey; it lacks Origin-landed continuity and proves nothing about full-story arrival, an earned Continue, or first-time naive UX.
Route waypoints were read from frozen chapter source, so this probe is instrumented manual play and can never support a no-private-knowledge first-time-usability claim.
manual rail is expected to be null in the manual lane; the probe reads rail/railCursor read-only and derives no target from an absent rail.

No source or telemetry bridge is added; anything the existing read-only bridge does not publish (e.g. a direct per-frame reference/sight boolean for the player) is reported as unavailable and treated as INCONCLUSIVE. Live reference is inferred only from credit accruing while walking, which is a proxy the source justifies but not a published predicate.
The self-tests validate harness logic only; they are not game tests and prove nothing about the chapter implementation.
The immutable 38803 preview is prior source; --url must be the root's future canonical URL. Nothing here authorizes a capture against it.
noAcceptance: This preparation grants no acceptance, closes no defect (CG-IMPL-009 and the conditional manual-corner risk remain open and unmeasured), and is not a creative or reviewer sign-off.
